summary: Wiley welcomes responsible author use of AI as a supplementary tool, with human oversight, rights/terms review, and disclosure when AI substantially edits, develops, or translates content (spelling/grammar tools are exempt). AI cannot be listed as an author. Reviewers and editors may use AI only to improve the clarity of written feedback (disclosed to the handling editor) and must not upload manuscripts or parts of them into AI tools.

evidence.quote: We welcome the responsible use of AI technology
AI Tools used solely for spelling, grammar, and general editing are not included in these disclosure requirements.
Authors must also disclose their use of AI Technologies when submitting a manuscript to a Wiley journal.
these tools cannot fulfil the role of an author and must not be listed as one on an article.
AI Technology may be used for creating data visualizations and illustrations, however, important restrictions apply to photograph enhancement
the reviewer must disclose that use to the handling editor when the review is submitted.
editors and peer reviewers are not permitted to upload manuscripts (or any parts of manuscripts including figures and tables) into AI Technology.
editors or peer reviewers may use AI Technology to help improve the clarity or quality of the written feedback
